Name: Void Pendant Replacer
Author: SkylarkL
Description:
If you are sick of looking at an ugly and lore-unfriendly recolor of the Mermaid pendant, this mod is for you! Say good-bye to the old dumb-looking shell, and -
Okay, this is making me sound like some kind of deranged pendant-obsessed weirdo, so here's a shorter version: I didn't like how the vanilla Void Ghost Pendant was just a shiny Mermaid Pendant, so I made a replacement for it. If you, too, are sick of its vanilla look, this mod is definitely for you.


Most other mods should work with this - the only ones that will conflict will be ones that also replace the Void Pendant sprite.

A shoutout to #making-mods (now #making-mods-general) on the SDV discord for all but spoonfeeding me the basics of making a Content Patcher mod, as well as FlashShifter - without them pointing out that I could make one, this would never come into existence.

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
